title: sfa2fieldsign
description: Computes fieldsign map from sfa-sess output. Masks the angle volumes and samples them to the surface.

fsig_bin.description: Intersection of polar and eccentricity thresholded fieldsigns

eccen_masked.description: Eccentricity angle (rad) volume masked by fieldsign bin

polar_masked.description: Polar angle (rad) volume masked by fieldsign bin

left_eccen_masked_mgh.description: Masked eccentricity angle sampled on the left hemisphere surface

left_polar_masked_mgh.description: Masked polar angle sampled on the left hemisphere surface

left_fieldsign_masked_mgh.description: Masked fieldsign map on left hemispehre

right_eccen_masked_mgh.description: Masked eccentricity angle sampled on the right hemisphere surface

right_polar_masked_mgh.description: Masked polar angle sampled on the right hemisphere surface

right_fieldsign_masked_mgh.description: Masked fieldsign map on the right hemisphere
